# Seabed: a sand floor (top near y -5.45) 18 m wide, 3 m deep, lumpy. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 0.671 0.337 0.459 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Floor --x-subdivisions 18 --y-subdivisions 3 --size 1 --location 0 0 -5.45
scale 18 3 1
apply --scale
material assign Sand
active Floor
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 2
mode object
add mesh cube --name Front --size 1 --location 0 -1.5 -5.85
scale 18 0.05 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Sand
